C0405.title: Credentials Still the 'Achilles' Heel'? Cisco's Latest Report Reveals New Threats from Old Attack Patterns
C0405.summary: Cisco's 2025 Cybersecurity Readiness Index cites the Cisco Talos 2024 Year in Review, which found identity-based attacks accounted for 60% of Talos incident response cases. The report says attackers relied on identity attacks for initial compromise, lateral movement, and privilege escalation, often extending dwell time by using compromised valid accounts and exposing risks from credential reuse, phishing, and abused cloud access tokens.
